description: Django template tags module defining custom template filters and tags for a recipes/cookbook web application, including markdown processing, URL generation, user preferences, and plugin templates.

methods.name: get_class_name
methods.description: Returns the class name of the given value.

methods.name: get_class
methods.description: Returns the class of the given value.

methods.name: class_name
methods.description: Template tag returning the class name of a value.

methods.name: delete_url
methods.description: Generates a delete URL for a given model and primary key.

methods.name: markdown
methods.description: Converts markdown text to sanitized HTML with extensions.

methods.name: recipe_rating
methods.description: Generates star rating HTML for a recipe based on user ratings.

methods.name: recipe_last
methods.description: Returns the last cooklog date for a recipe and user.

methods.name: page_help
methods.description: Provides help page links based on page name.

methods.name: message_of_the_day
methods.description: Returns the message of the day for a request's space.

methods.name: markdown_link
methods.description: Provides a markdown formatting help link.

methods.name: plugin_dropdown_nav_templates
methods.description: Returns nav dropdown templates from plugins.

methods.name: plugin_main_nav_templates
methods.description: Returns main nav templates from plugins.

methods.name: bookmarklet
methods.description: Generates a bookmarklet link with user token and server info.

methods.name: base_path
methods.description: Returns base or static URL paths based on request and type.

methods.name: user_prefs
methods.description: Serializes user preferences for a request.
